plain.li: [r3newborn] The little {WHAT} is warm, and look at the snow round it, trodden flat in a ring.
[r3newborn] Something lay round this {WHAT} all night to keep it warm, something big.
[r3newborn] It should have frozen out here, and it's as warm as if it slept by the fire.
[r3newborn,doubt] The mother must have walked round and round it all night, that's all.
[r3newborn,doubt] Lucky little {WHAT}, its mother trod the snow down round it.
[r3ripen] The {WHAT} is ripe, all of it, and this morning it wasn't.
[r3ripen] Look at the field, it ripened in the heat while we stood here.
[r3ripen] The sun gave us the whole field at once today.
[r3ripen,doubt] It's the heat, it brings a crop on fast when it's this hot.
[r3ripen,doubt] It was nearly ripe anyway, the heat just finished it.
[r3foxfire] There's a green light on the ground {WHAT}, come and look.
[r3foxfire] Something is glowing out there {WHAT}, low down in the wet.
[r3foxfire] That light on the ground isn't a fire, it's too green.
[r3foxfire,doubt] Rotten wood glows like that sometimes, it's nothing.
[r3richsoil] The ground where that light was is black and rich now.
[r3richsoil] Feel this soil {WHAT}, it was hard and grey yesterday.
[r3richsoil] Whatever was glowing out there last night left good earth behind.
[r3richsoil,doubt] The wet has just rotted the leaves down there, that's all.
[r3pipnight] There are sparks at the bench and nobody's there.
[r3pipnight] Someone's at the bench with the {WHAT}, but I can't see anyone.
[r3pipnight,doubt] Must be a spark left in the bench, I'll look in the morning.
[r3finished] The {WHAT} is nearly done, and I left it half made.
[r3finished] Who worked on the {WHAT} in the night, it was nowhere near this far.
[r3finished] Somebody finished most of the {WHAT} while we were asleep.
[r3finished,doubt] I must have done more on the {WHAT} yesterday than I thought.
[r3tide] The sea has come right up the sand {WHAT}, I've never seen it so far up.
[r3tide] Look at the water, it's come up with the moon.
[r3tide] The tide is up past the rocks tonight, further than it ever comes.
[r3tide,doubt] It's a big tide with the full moon, it happens.
[r3glory] There's a giant in the mist, and it moves when I move.
[r3glory] Look at that, a great shadow on the fog with a ring of light round its head.
[r3glory] Something is standing in the mist and looking back at me.
[r3glory,doubt] It's only my own shadow on the fog, but it's a big one.
[r3glory,doubt] That's my shadow in the mist, the sun's behind me.
